prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video-ad maker — the right one depends on what you need (budget, style, platform, scale, personalization). Below are top options and when each tends to be the best choice, plus quick guidance on how to pick.

Top contenders (short pros/cons)
- Synthesia — Great for polished presenter-led ads using realistic AI avatars and multilingual TTS. Pros: high-quality avatars, easy script → video. Cons: less flexible for heavy scene-editing; costlier for enterprise features.
- Canva (Video/Vimeo Create / InVideo similar) — Best all‑around for small teams and social ads. Pros: huge template library, drag‑and‑drop, fast outputs, affordable. Cons: less advanced generative video capabilities.
- HeyGen / Movio — Strong for customizable AI presenters and quick localized ad variants. Pros: simple workflow for many languages. Cons: avatar variety and realism vary by provider.
- Pictory / Vidyo.ai — Best for repurposing long-form content into short social ads. Pros: automated highlight extraction, subtitle generation. Cons: limited scene-by-scene creative control.
- Runway — Best for advanced generative creative (text-to-video, complex edits). Pros: cutting-edge generative tools and flexible editing. Cons: steeper learning curve and variable cost.
- Descript — Best if you need editing + voice cloning/overdub for ad edits. Pros: powerful transcript-driven editing, realistic overdubs. Cons: not focused on templates/advertising assets.

Which to pick by use case
- Quick social ads on a budget: Canva or InVideo (fast templates, multiple aspect ratios).
- Presenter-led or multilingual ads where brand spokesperson is needed: Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Repurposing webinars/podcasts into short ads: Pictory or Vidyo.ai.
- Experimental, cinematic, or novel generative visuals: Runway.
- Frequent iterative edits with voice cloning: Descript.

How to choose and test
- Define must-haves: aspect ratios, voice languages, live-action vs avatar, integrations (ads manager, CMS), per-video cost, and output quality.
- Run a short A/B test: create the same 15–30s ad in 2–3 platforms, test on a small audience or with team feedback for quality, load time, and cost.
- Check rights/licensing (stock clips, music, AI voice usage) and export formats.
- Consider scale needs: Do you need dynamic personalization and many localized variants? That changes the recommended platform.

If you tell me your budget, ad style (avatar, live footage, animated, repurposed), platform (Facebook/Meta, YouTube, TikTok), and whether you need localization or personalization at scale, I’ll recommend 1–2 specific platforms and a step-by-step trial plan.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
